info.short_description: State name, or "United States" for the national total.
info.long_description: Geographic identifier as a human-readable name: a state name, or the literal "United States" for the national total. The matching FIPS code is in geography_fips. Only the 50 states, DC, and the national total are kept; territories and non-state NNDSS jurisdictions (for example New York City) are dropped. The ABCs files are national only, and even then cover a catchment of roughly 35 million people rather than the whole country.

info.short_description: FIPS code for the geography; "00" is the national total.
info.long_description: FIPS code for the row's geography, kept alongside the human-readable name so these files can be joined to other FIPS-keyed data. "00" is the national total and 2-digit codes are states. Stored as a string to preserve the leading zero.

info.short_description: Period end date in YYYY-mm-dd (ISO 8601) format.
info.long_description: End date of the reporting period. Resolution differs by file: Epic Cosmos is quarterly (last day of the calendar quarter), NNDSS is weekly (MMWR week ending Saturday), and the ABCs files are annual (YYYY-12-31).

info.short_description: Group A or Group B Streptococcus.
info.long_description: Which organism the row describes: "Group A Streptococcus" (Streptococcus pyogenes) or "Group B Streptococcus" (Streptococcus agalactiae). These are different diseases with different at-risk populations - Group A causes strep throat and invasive disease across all ages, Group B is primarily neonatal sepsis and invasive disease in older adults - so do not pool them.

info.short_description: Age group; the all-ages level overlaps the specific bands.
info.long_description: Age group for the row. Epic Cosmos uses "Total" and so do the ABCs files; either overlaps the specific bands, so exclude it before summing across ages. ABCs bands differ by topic - rates use <1 / 1 / 2-4 / 5-17 / 18-34 / 35-49 / 50-64 / 65+, while resistance and typing use the coarser <1 / 18-64 / 65+. ABCs reports no 2-17 band for Group B.

info.short_description: Early-onset (0-6 days) vs late-onset (7-89 days) infant Group B disease.
info.long_description: Group B Streptococcus is the leading cause of neonatal sepsis, so CDC splits infant disease by onset timing: early-onset (0-6 days of life, usually acquired around delivery) and late-onset (7-89 days). Rows with "Overall" are not onset-specific - the onset rows are a subset of infants, not additional population, so do not sum across this column.

info.short_description: Number of emm-typed isolates that were emm 1.
info.long_description: Number of emm-typed invasive Group A Streptococcus isolates belonging to emm 1, as published by CDC alongside the proportion. The per-type counts sum to abcs_gas_emm_n_isolates_total. Active Bacterial Core surveillance (ABCs) is population-based but covers a defined catchment of selected US counties - roughly 35 million people - not the entire country. Rates are observed within that catchment; counts labelled national are CDC's population-weighted extrapolations. Values are national only, with no state or county breakdown.

info.short_description: Cumulative year-to-date case count of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome.
info.long_description: Cumulative year-to-date number of reported cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome (STSS), a life-threatening condition caused by group A Streptococcus, as reported through the NNDSS.

stss_cases_weekly.long_name: Weekly incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome
stss_cases_weekly.short_description: Newly reported STSS cases in the MMWR week.
stss_cases_weekly.long_description: Incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome newly reported in the MMWR week, derived by build.R as the week-over-week difference in the cumulative year-to-date count within each geography and MMWR year. This is the series to plot. NNDSS occasionally revises earlier weeks downward, producing a small number of negative increments; these are left as reported rather than clamped, and build.R logs the count. Note STSS is the only Group A measure NNDSS carries - invasive Group A disease generally, and Group B disease, are not nationally notifiable.

info.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column (see that column for units).
info.long_description: Reported case count of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome. The measure column distinguishes the weekly-incident series from the cumulative year-to-date series as published by NNDSS. The two are not additive - do not sum across measures.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|age.short_description: Age group; the all-ages level overlaps the specific bands.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|age.long_description: Age group for the row. Epic Cosmos uses "Total" and so do the ABCs files; either overlaps the specific bands, so exclude it before summing across ages. ABCs bands differ by topic - rates use <1 / 1 / 2-4 / 5-17 / 18-34 / 35-49 / 50-64 / 65+, while resistance and typing use the coarser <1 / 18-64 / 65+. ABCs reports no 2-17 band for Group B.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|ons.short_description: Early-onset (0-6 days) vs late-onset (7-89 days) infant Group B disease.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|ons.long_description: Group B Streptococcus is the leading cause of neonatal sepsis, so CDC splits infant disease by onset timing: early-onset (0-6 days of life, usually acquired around delivery) and late-onset (7-89 days). Rows with "Overall" are not onset-specific - the onset rows are a subset of infants, not additional population, so do not sum across this column.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|pat.short_description: Group A or Group B Streptococcus.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_gas_emm.parquet|pat.long_description: Which organism the row describes: "Group A Streptococcus" (Streptococcus pyogenes) or "Group B Streptococcus" (Streptococcus agalactiae). These are different diseases with different at-risk populations - Group A causes strep throat and invasive disease across all ages, Group B is primarily neonatal sepsis and invasive disease in older adults - so do not pool them.

info.short_description: Number of emm-typed isolates that were emm 1.
info.long_description: Number of emm-typed invasive Group A Streptococcus isolates belonging to emm 1, as published by CDC alongside the proportion. The per-type counts sum to abcs_gas_emm_n_isolates_total. Active Bacterial Core surveillance (ABCs) is population-based but covers a defined catchment of selected US counties - roughly 35 million people - not the entire country. Rates are observed within that catchment; counts labelled national are CDC's population-weighted extrapolations. Values are national only, with no state or county breakdown.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep_resistance.pa.long_description: Group B Streptococcus is the leading cause of neonatal sepsis, so CDC splits infant disease by onset timing: early-onset (0-6 days of life, usually acquired around delivery) and late-onset (7-89 days). Rows with "Overall" are not onset-specific - the onset rows are a subset of infants, not additional population, so do not sum across this column.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep_resistance.pa.short_description: Group A or Group B Streptococcus.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep_resistance.pa.long_description: Which organism the row describes: "Group A Streptococcus" (Streptococcus pyogenes) or "Group B Streptococcus" (Streptococcus agalactiae). These are different diseases with different at-risk populations - Group A causes strep throat and invasive disease across all ages, Group B is primarily neonatal sepsis and invasive disease in older adults - so do not pool them.

info.short_description: Quarterly total patient count used as the denominator for the strep throat percentage.
info.long_description: Quarterly total count of patients, used as the denominator for epic_pct_strep_throat. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. info.long_name: Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
info.short_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
info.long_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, including streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_strep_throat_suppressed_flag. Quarters only partially covered by the exported date range are dropped, so every value covers a full calendar quarter. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.

info.long_name: Percent of Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
info.short_description: Quarterly percent of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
info.long_description: Quarterly percentage of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, computed as epic_n_strep_throat / epic_n_patients * 100. Diagnosis codes include streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing, because dividing by the imputed denominator of 5 would assert a meaningless value; those cells are marked by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.

bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|value.long_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column. Units are mixed: n_strep_throat and n_patients are patient counts, pct_strep_throat is a percent (0-100). Always filter or facet by measure before plotting. The denominator counts patients with ANY encounter, not emergency department visits only, so pct_strep_throat is not an ED visit share.

bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.long_name: Suppression flag for this measure value
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.short_description: 1 if Epic suppressed the underlying cell and the value was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise.
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos withheld the underlying cell (a count of 10 or fewer) and the value was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Measure-specific: for n_strep_throat and pct_strep_throat it reflects suppression of the strep throat numerator, and for n_patients the patient-total denominator. Computed upstream before imputation, so it records what Epic withheld rather than what the ingest wrote. Distinct from not_reported in the ABCs files, which marks data the source never published.

info.short_description: Cumulative year-to-date case count of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome.
info.long_description: Cumulative year-to-date number of reported cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome (STSS), a life-threatening condition caused by group A Streptococcus, as reported through the NNDSS.

stss_cases_weekly.long_name: Weekly incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome
stss_cases_weekly.short_description: Newly reported STSS cases in the MMWR week.
stss_cases_weekly.long_description: Incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome newly reported in the MMWR week, derived by build.R as the week-over-week difference in the cumulative year-to-date count within each geography and MMWR year. This is the series to plot. NNDSS occasionally revises earlier weeks downward, producing a small number of negative increments; these are left as reported rather than clamped, and build.R logs the count. Note STSS is the only Group A measure NNDSS carries - invasive Group A disease generally, and Group B disease, are not nationally notifiable.

bundle_gas/dist/nnds_stss.parquet|value.long_description: Reported case count of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome. The measure column distinguishes the weekly-incident series from the cumulative year-to-date series as published by NNDSS. The two are not additive - do not sum across measures.
